comparison.scope: Mean of independent ordinary-step run medians; validation runs excluded.

limitation: Binary/checkpoint/VTK payloads omitted; cluster-computed hashes and numerical reports verified, not rerun.
correctness: All thirteen runs passed; checked 16-rank run and independent 16/167-rank oracles passed; each oracle proved all 48 inverse returns including 12 accepted exits. Restart/remap, storage, physical placement, zero-Domain ranks, checkpoint and 62 VTK members verified.
reason: Both order-balanced candidate/Stage230 pairs improve by 15.273 and 13.106 ms. Every candidate median is lower than every Stage230 median; initial evidence supports improvement without the optional repeat. This qualifies the tested change at 83 ranks, not legacy parity or speed at other rank counts.
inherited_main_gap: Candidate remains 210.321151 ms (+38.748617%) slower than main. The gain closes 6.320073% of the matched Stage230/main gap.
attribution_limit: Original untiled Stage265 was not run in this allocation; no causal speed gain against it is claimed.
next_action: Recommend retaining fab72486 as the next comparison baseline. Next inspect and separately measure omission of the first full block installation on provisional production exits; preserve final exits, oracle installation and boundary epochs.
